title: Roll the fail-closed, least-privilege gateway out to qa and prod inside the allowed windows
description: Release the merged change per sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess: environmentsOrder dev -> qa -> prod, approvalsRequired 1, rollbackPlanRequired true, changeTypeDefault normal; releaseProcess defines no deploymentWindows and neither env/qa.json nor env/prod.json records a changeFreeze, so schedule the prod rollout inside the only recorded window, env/prod.json probeAccess.allowedWindows Mon-Fri 16:30-23:30 UTC. Deploy the new image to EKS eks-nonprod-mumbai namespace mcp-gateway-qa (qa first) and eks-prod-mumbai namespace mcp-gateway with per-environment tool allow-lists agreed with the order-routing critical-function owners, because the prod gateway is partner-exposed and holds pii and financial data; record the previous image tag and previous env values in the change ticket so the initiative rollbackPlan is executable without research.
acceptanceCriteria: The new image runs in both EKS namespaces (mcp-gateway-qa on eks-nonprod-mumbai, mcp-gateway on eks-prod-mumbai) with the release approval recorded, and the prod deployment timestamp falls inside Mon-Fri 16:30-23:30 UTC.

From an MCP client that omits the elicitation capability, tools/call of a confirmation-required tool is refused with the security log line emitted in qa and in prod, and tools/list in each environment returns only the allow-listed tools.
The change ticket records the previous image tag and previous env values, so the initiative rollbackPlan can be executed as a single redeploy without research.

verificationMethod.description: After each rollout (qa first, then prod inside the allowed window), connect an elicitation-incapable MCP client to the deployed gateway, attempt tools/call of a confirmation-required tool (the refusal happens before any execution, so no data is touched) and list tools: expected result - the call is refused with the security event logged and tools/list shows only allow-listed tools; capture the command output as task evidence.

rootCause.description: The insecure userConfig defaults were carried into the shipped deploy configuration (deploy/aws/Dockerfile overrode only the atlas-local category), so the gateway reached qa and prod with 11 unconfirmed write tools enabled and a fail-open confirmation path.
